513982.name: The Cairns
513982.description:
We offer Self-Guided Tours by Appointment Only. The Cairns apartments in Seattle, WA offer a lifestyle immersed in culture and surrounded by adventure. Situated between Capitol Hill and South Lake Union, our community is uniquely positioned to offer access to all the best of the city, with sweeping skyline views and a sophisticated, modern home to match.

Choose from our studio, one-, or two-bedroom residences, all featuring a fully equipped kitchen that is ideal for entertaining guests. Inside each home, you’ll also find a combination of wood-style flooring and carpeting, ample storage space, and an in-unit washer and dryer. Showcasing beautiful views of the city, your Juliet-inspired balcony is perfect for an herb garden and a breath of fresh air.

Around our community, you will find a host of amenities that contribute to the convenience of everyday life, such as a 24-hour fitness center, a clubhouse, and a dog park for your furry friend. Perhaps best of all is our fantastic rooftop deck, with entertaining area and sparkling city views.

Just beyond our community, daily conveniences are minutes away. Whole Foods, Amazon Go, and 24-Hour Fitness, along with many nearby attractions like the Space Needle and the Museum of History & Industry (MOHAI) are all within easy reach.

If you must travel farther, getting around the city is a breeze on the South Lake Union Streetcar and with easy access to I-5.

The City of Seattle Renter's Handbook (PDF) summarizes the rental regulations and outlines the obligations and responsibilities of both tenants and landlords. A paper copy is available from the Leasing Office upon request. This community does not accept reusable (portable) tenant screening reports.

Price reflected is base rent and does not include mandatory or optional fees. Detailed fee information and fee schedules can be found on the community's Leasing Info page on our Essex website.

pet_policy.restrictions: A deposit of $250 is required for up to 2 pets.

A deposit of $250 is required for up to 2 pets.  We do not allow guardian dog breeds/crossbreeds, such as Alaskan Malamutes, Rottweilers, Doberman Pinschers, Pit Bulls, German Shepherds, Akitas, Bullmastiffs, Mastiffs, Wolf Dogs or any dog that the landlord believes is a related breed. Restrictions are subject to change without notice. Restrictions do not apply to dogs that aid disabled individuals for equal access to housing.

513982.parking_notes:
The Cairns may have Assigned Parking Garage spaces available for rent for $225 per month.

Additional parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Parking availability and pricing are not guaranteed and subject to change without notice. For further inquiries, please reach out to our leasing team.

514001.name: Patent 523
514001.description:
We offer Self-Guided Tours by Appointment Only. Come home to modern luxury surrounded by everyday conveniences at Patent 523 in Seattle, WA.

Enjoy a home finished with modern design and enhanced by luxurious features such as large closets, designer cabinetry, wood-style flooring, and an in-home washer and dryer for your convenience. Select from our studio, one-, or two-bedroom floor plans, plus one-bedroom loft-style apartment homes to find the perfect one to suit your needs. Enjoy open-concept kitchens, large windows, and tall ceilings that create an open and airy home filled with natural light.

Around our community, you will find a variety of amenities in which to indulge. Our barbecue area and courtyard are perfect for lounging around on a sunny day. Work up a sweat in our fitness center or practice quiet meditation in our yoga studio. Our rooftop deck showcases breathtaking cityscapes, inviting you to unwind amid one-of-a-kind urban beauty.

Outside of our community, you will find all the essentials for living, entertaining, and more. Make the Capitol Hill Farmer’s Market a regular weekend stop to pick up some fresh produce. Head to Spin Cycle to pick up some records or spend the day at Volunteer Park enjoying the beautiful trails and landscapes. Getting around Seattle is a breeze with the Capitol Hill Light Rail Station just a few blocks away or hop on I-5 to easily access the rest of the Pacific Northwest.

518107.name: Annaliese
518107.description:
We offer Self-Guided Tours by Appointment Only. At Annaliese apartments in Seattle, WA, we focus on creating a space that is functional, sophisticated, and modern–all at a convenient central locale.

Our open-concept one- and one-bedroom-plus-den floor plans are sure to suit your lifestyle. Each apartment home showcases modern design with contemporary features such as stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, floor-to-ceiling windows, and wood-style flooring. Within each apartment for rent, you will also find conveniences such as a washer and dryer, large closets, and a cozy electric fireplace. Select homes invite you to extend your living space outdoors on your own private patio or balcony.

Outside our community, you won’t have to travel far to find everything you need. Our central location is within a short distance of a variety of daily conveniences like grocery stores, restaurants, and cafés. Grab some grub at neighborhood favorite, 5 Point Café, or check out amazing memorabilia at the Museum of Pop Culture. If retail therapy is more your style, the Westlake Shopping Center is less than a mile down the road.

Whether you stay in the neighborhood, or commute throughout Seattle or beyond, getting around is a breeze using the Link Light Rail, King County Metro, the Monorail, or Zipcar. Plus, easy access to I-5 will take you beyond the city to a variety of gorgeous nature escapes.
